description: Emit health observations for an external Snowflake table.

asset_key.label: Asset Key
asset_key.description: Asset key of the ExternalSnowflakeTableAsset to observe

include_preview_metadata.description: Run an extra `SELECT * LIMIT preview_rows` against the table and include the result as a markdown preview on the AssetObservation.
include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata

preview_rows.description: Rows in the preview SELECT when include_preview_metadata=True.
preview_rows.label: Preview Rows

private_key_file_env_var.label: Private Key File Env Var
private_key_file_env_var.description: Env var holding the path to a PEM RSA private key file (for authenticator='SNOWFLAKE_JWT').

private_key_file_pwd_env_var.label: Private Key File Pwd Env Var
private_key_file_pwd_env_var.description: Env var holding the passphrase for an encrypted private key file (optional).

token_env_var.label: Token Env Var
token_env_var.description: Env var holding an OAuth / PAT token (with authenticator='oauth' or PAT).

emit_materialization.description: When True (default), the sensor emits AssetMaterialization. When False, emits AssetObservation instead. Only used when create_observation_sensor=True.
emit_materialization.label: Emit Materialization

name: Snowflake Table Observation Sensor
